overview: The pre-release builtin hytalegenerator subsystem (~568 types across 70+ sub-packages under com.hypixel.hytale.builtin.hytalegenerator) is a major refactor of the stable worldgen builtin. The high-level architecture is preserved — a JavaPlugin entry point (HytaleGenerator), a staged chunk generation pipeline (StagedChunkGenerator), a density function graph, and a comprehensive JSON asset system — but the internals have been substantially reorganized. Key changes: (1) The 'newsystem' namespace has been promoted to 'engine' — the N-prefix is dropped from all types (NStagedChunkGenerator -> StagedChunkGenerator, NStage -> Stage, etc.). (2) The prop system has been redesigned with a new single-method Prop.generate() API replacing the old scan()+place() two-phase protocol. Old props (BoxProp, ClusterProp, ColumnProp, etc.) are moved to props/deprecated/. New prop types include LocatorProp, ManualProp, MaskProp, OrienterProp, StaticRotatorProp, DensitySelectorProp, CuboidProp (distinct from old BoxProp). (3) A new 'pipe' package provides Control/Pipe flow-control primitives used by the new prop/scanner/position-provider APIs. (4) A new 'rng' package (Rng, RngField) replaces the old SeedGenerator/CoPrimeGenerator with faster bitwise noise hashing. (5) PropField is replaced by PropRuntime which pairs a runtime index with a PropDistribution. (6) The 'assignments' package is now a top-level package (was nested under propdistributions). (7) Position providers gain new types: Jitter2d/3d, SquareGrid2d/3d, TriangularGrid2d, ClustersPositionProvider, ScalerPositionProvider, EmptyPositionProvider. Old Mesh2D/3D move to deprecated/. (8) Scanners are redesigned: new types DirectScanner, LinearScanner, RadialScanner, QueueScanner, RandomScanner, EmptyScanner replace old OriginScanner, ColumnLinearScanner, AreaScanner (moved to deprecated/). (9) The 'propdistributions' package replaces the old 'propdistributions' (Assignments-based) with PropDistribution hierarchy featuring AssignedPropDistribution, PositionsPropDistribution, UnionPropDistribution. (10) New voxelspace types: MaskVoxelSpace, RotationVoxelSpace. (11) New engine types: EntityFunnel interface with RotationEntityFunnel, FloatContainer3d. (12) Patterns gain ConstantPattern and RotatorPattern. (13) BiCarta is now @Deprecated, moved to worldstructure package. (14) The biome system drops BiomeType/SimpleBiomeType parallel hierarchy and the getBiomeName() method from Biome interface.

delta_from_stable.summary: Major architectural refactor: 'newsystem' promoted to 'engine', prop system redesigned with single-method API, new pipe/rng packages, position providers and scanners overhauled with new types and deprecations.

plugin_entry.overview: The HytaleGenerator class remains the JavaPlugin entry point. Key changes: (1) imports reference 'engine' package instead of 'newsystem'. (2) Stage pipeline building uses non-N-prefixed types (StagedChunkGenerator, Stage, BiomeStage, etc.). (3) PropRuntime replaces PropField for runtime index tracking. (4) PositionProvider.generate() API replaces old positionsIn() pattern. (5) PositionProvider.Context now uses Pipe-based flow control.

types.role: JavaPlugin entry point. Manages AssetManager, executor pools, generator caching. createStagedChunkGenerator() builds the full StagedChunkGenerator pipeline from assets using PropRuntime instead of PropField. submitChunkRequest() dispatches generation to a single-threaded mainExecutor with semaphore protection. Falls back to FallbackGenerator on errors.

engine.overview: The 'engine' package (~29 types, renamed from 'newsystem') implements the staged chunk generation pipeline. The N-prefix is dropped from all types. Architecture is preserved: StagedChunkGenerator processes chunks through a sequence of Stage instances operating on a shared BufferBundle. New additions include EntityFunnel interface for entity placement abstraction, FloatContainer3d for 3D float data, and RotationEntityFunnel for rotated entity placement.
engine.architecture: StagedChunkGenerator implements ChunkGenerator interface. For each chunk: (1) creates buffer accesses for all stages, (2) iterates stages sequentially, (3) within each stage, splits buffer tile positions across workers for parallel execution, (4) after all stages, transfers results from buffers to GeneratedChunk (materials, tints, environments, entities, block states) in parallel. Buffer tiles are 8x8x8 voxels. World height is 320 blocks = 40 buffer tiles vertically. Chunks are 32x32 = 4x4 buffer tiles horizontally.

new_types.role: NEW. Interface for abstracting entity placement. addEntity(EntityPlacementData), getBounds(). NULL static singleton does nothing. Used by Prop.Context to decouple entity writing from direct buffer access.
NEW. EntityFunnel that applies rotation to entity positions and transforms before delegating to a source EntityFunnel. Used by StaticRotatorProp for rotated prefab entity placement.
NEW. 3D float array with bounds checking, indexed by YXZ order. moveMinTo() for repositioning. Used for terrain density caching.

pipe.overview: NEW package. Provides flow-control primitives used throughout the redesigned prop/scanner/position-provider systems. The pipe pattern replaces the old consumer-based iteration with explicit stop control.

types.role: NEW. Flow control object with a boolean 'stop' field. When set to true, the current iteration stops. reset() clears the flag.

NEW. Container for functional interfaces. Pipe.One<Input> accepts (Input, Control). Pipe.Two<InputA, InputB> accepts (InputA, InputB, Control). EMPTY_ONE and EMPTY_TWO static no-op instances. Used by PositionProvider, PropDistribution, and Scanner for stoppable iteration.

rng.overview: NEW package (partially). SeedBox existed in stable but was in a different location. Rng and RngField are new, providing fast bitwise deterministic noise hashing to replace the old CoPrimeGenerator/SeedGenerator approach.

types.role: NEW. Static bitwise noise hashing. getRandomInt(seed, key) uses bit manipulation (BIT_NOISE_0/1/2 constants). mix(seed, a, b) and mix(seed, a, b, c) combine coordinates with prime multipliers. splitMixLong/splitMixInteger for additional mixing. rotateLeft() bit utility.

NEW. Seed-keyed spatial noise field. get(x,y,z) and get(x,y) use Rng.mix(). Also supports double inputs via Float.floatToRawIntBits(). Replaces old SeedGenerator for position-deterministic random selection.
Moved from root package to rng/. Hierarchical seed container using string keys. Unchanged API.

prop_system.overview: The prop system has been fundamentally redesigned. The old two-phase scan()+place() protocol is replaced by a single generate(Context) method returning boolean (success). Old prop types (BoxProp, ClusterProp, ColumnProp, etc.) are moved to props/deprecated/. New prop types provide cleaner abstractions. Prop.Context now includes separate materialReadSpace and materialWriteSpace (was single materialSpace in stable), plus EntityFunnel for entity placement. ScanResult is eliminated from the new API.

CHANGED: Prop.Context gains separate materialReadSpace/materialWriteSpace (was single VoxelSpace<Material>)

new_prop_types.role: Abstract base. generate(Context) -> boolean. getReadBounds_voxelGrid() and getWriteBounds_voxelGrid() return Bounds3i. Context holds position, materialReadSpace, materialWriteSpace (separate read/write), EntityFunnel, distanceToBiomeEdge. Copy constructor and assign() for context cloning.
NEW. Singleton no-op prop. INSTANCE always returns true from generate(). Zero bounds.
NEW. Places a solid cuboid of material within configured bounds. Uses MaterialProvider for per-voxel material selection with depth metrics. Replaces old BoxProp with cleaner API.

REDESIGNED. Evaluates density function across bounding range, computes solidity buffer, then calculates depth/space metrics per column for material selection. Uses separate solidityBuffer with expanded Y bounds for boundary detection. Much cleaner implementation than stable version.
NEW. Selects child prop based on density function value at position. Uses DelimiterDouble<Prop> list with range matching. Like SelectorDensity but for props.

NEW. Scans for valid positions using Scanner+Pattern, then places a child prop at each found position up to placementCap. Uses Pipe flow control for stoppable scanning. Replaces the old scan-then-place workflow with a unified approach.
NEW. Places a fixed list of Block records (position offset + material) relative to the origin. Used for hand-crafted small structures.
NEW. Wraps a child prop with a BlockMask filter via MaskVoxelSpace. Only allows writes that pass the mask's canPlace/canReplace checks.

NEW. Tests multiple rotation variants via RotatorPattern, selects a valid rotation (first match, all valid, or random), then generates the appropriately-rotated child prop. SelectionMode enum controls selection strategy. Uses Scanner for position finding.
NEW. Applies a fixed rotation to a child prop using RotationVoxelSpace for material transforms and RotationEntityFunnel for entity transforms. Rotation-aware bounds calculation.
REDESIGNED. Still places PrefabBuffer structures, but uses the new generate() API. Uses EntityFunnel for entity placement.
REDESIGNED. Flood-fill pond generator using new Prop API.
Tries child props in sequence; uses the first one that returns true. Unchanged concept, new API.
Generates all child props. Unchanged concept, new API.
Randomly selects one child prop using RngField (replaces old SeedGenerator). New API.

NEW. Wraps a child PropDistribution and overrides the prop assignment using an Assignments instance. The isOverrideAllProps flag controls whether existing non-empty props are replaced.
NEW. Generates positions from a PositionProvider and pairs each with EmptyProp. The downstream AssignedPropDistribution then assigns actual props.
NEW. Concatenates output from multiple child PropDistributions.

changes_from_stable: REMOVED: Bounds3d (decimal bounds removed)
REMOVED: SpaceSize (deprecated type fully removed)
RETAINED: Bounds3i with expanded API (applyRotationAroundVoxel, undoRotationAroundVoxel, encompass, ZERO static constant)

delimiters.overview: Unchanged. RangeDouble, RangeInt, DelimiterDouble, DelimiterInt all retained.

tintproviders.overview: Unchanged. TintProvider, ConstantTintProvider, DensityDelimitedTintProvider, NoTintProvider retained.

vectorproviders.overview: Unchanged. VectorProvider, ConstantVectorProvider, DensityGradientVectorProvider, CacheVectorProvider retained.

referencebundle.overview: Simplified. Only ReferenceBundle remains. Reference base class and BaseHeightReference removed.
changes_from_stable: REMOVED: Reference (empty base class)
REMOVED: BaseHeightReference
RETAINED: ReferenceBundle

workerindexer.overview: Unchanged. WorkerIndexer with Id, Data, Session inner classes retained.

server_worldgen_interfaces.IWorldGenProvider: HandleProvider implements IWorldGenProvider, registered via IWorldGenProvider.CODEC.register('HytaleGenerator', ...) in HytaleGenerator.setup()
server_worldgen_interfaces.IWorldGen: Handle implements IWorldGen. Now also implements getDefaultSpawnProvider() and getTimings().
server_worldgen_interfaces.GeneratedChunk: StagedChunkGenerator produces GeneratedChunk with GeneratedBlockChunk, GeneratedBlockStateChunk, GeneratedEntityChunk, and section Holders.

ecs_components.ChunkStore: Used via Holder<ChunkStore> in SolidMaterial for block state management.
ecs_components.FluidSection: StagedChunkGenerator.transferMaterials() writes fluid data to FluidSection per chunk section.
ecs_components.BlockPhysics: StagedChunkGenerator.setSupport() uses BlockPhysics for block physics state.
ecs_components.EntityStore: EntityPlacementData.entityHolder (Holder<EntityStore>) spawns entities. Used by EntityFunnel.
ecs_components.TransformComponent: RotationEntityFunnel accesses TransformComponent for entity position/rotation transforms.

events.RemoveWorldEvent: HytaleGenerator listens globally and removes cached generators when worlds are removed.
events.LoadedAssetsEvent: AssetManager uses this to trigger asset loading and reload callbacks.

commands.ViewportCommand: Registered by HytaleGenerator. Now references BuilderToolsPlugin for block selection.

cross_references.new_dependency_buildertools: ViewportCommand now imports com.hypixel.hytale.builtin.buildertools.BuilderToolsPlugin for block selection access (new cross-plugin dependency).
cross_references.prop_pipeline_flow: PropStage -> Biome.getRuntimesWithIndex() -> PropRuntime.getPropDistribution() -> PropDistribution.generate() yields (position, prop) pairs -> Prop.generate(Context) writes to materialWriteSpace + EntityFunnel
cross_references.relationship_to_server_worldgen: Unchanged relationship. The builtin hytalegenerator remains the active world generation implementation replacing the old server.worldgen pipeline.

removed_types_summary.overview: ~211 types removed from the public API. Most are either moved to deprecated sub-packages, removed math/framework utilities, or eliminated parallel hierarchies.

files_read.method: All 568 Java files in the pre-release decompiled source were read via cat/head commands in batched shell scripts. Key architectural files (plugin/, engine/, density/, props/, positionproviders/, scanners/, assignments/, propdistributions/, biome/, worldstructure/, patterns/, pipe/, rng/) were read in full. Asset files were read via import analysis of AssetManager.java (267 imports catalogued). Supporting packages (material/, materialproviders/, voxelspace/, bounds/, delimiters/, environmentproviders/, tintproviders/, vectorproviders/, rangemaps/, referencebundle/, workerindexer/, math/, noise/, cartas/, commands/) were read via headers (first 30 lines) to confirm type structure and API.
